# Russian routing rule sets

Bundled binary rule sets for sing-box:

- `geoip-ru.srs`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SagerNet/sing-geoip/rule-set/geoip-ru.srs
- `geosite-category-ru.srs`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SagerNet/sing-geosite/rule-set/geosite-category-ru.srs

Downloaded from the official SagerNet repositories on 2026-09-04. Update both files together and validate them with the bundled sing-box executable before publishing a new installer.
